snippet.title: Don't Freak - ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: https://rabbitrungames.itch.io/dont-freak

Tales of the long abandoned grounds of the Freakerland amusement park have long since haunted your town. Many have entered to try and uncover its secrets, but none have returned. Do you have what it takes?

Find the Freak Phones, uncover the truth, and escape the park alive in Don't Freak, the terrifying new game by Rabbit Run Games.

Copyright: Freddiefreaker.com 2017

(ALPHA 0.5.1)
